exposure: successful trial of labour after previous scar (sTOLAC)
failed trial of labour after previous scar (fTOLAC) ending in repeat Caesarean section
indication of Caesarean section in previous delivery
previous history of normal vaginal delivery
cohort: The study included 610 patients attempting a trial of labour after a previous Caesarean section.
finding: Patients with a previous history of normal vaginal delivery, increased parity, and birth weight less than 3 kg had a better chance of a successful Vaginal Birth after Caesarean section, resulting in fewer complications and a decreased overall Caesarean section rate.
mod_finding: Successful Vaginal Birth after Caesarean section was associated with fewer complications compared to failed trial of labour ending in repeat Caesarean section, particularly for those with a previous vaginal delivery, higher parity, and birth weight under 3 kg.
birth_weight: Included; mentioned as a variable, specifically 'birth weight less than 3 kg'
